items.name: Ültja Erdnüsse gesalzen
items.label: ÜLTJA
items.description: Parody of the Ültje peanut can: fat sun-yellow can with a glossy cobalt lid and a cobalt label band reading ÜLTJA above one golden peanut

items.name: Honigtal Mandeln
items.description: Fat lavender standing pouch with a honey-yellow crimped seal and a cream label panel with two tan almonds. Invented German brand Honigtal, product Mandeln.

items.name: Sanftbucht Cashewkerne
items.description: Fat turquoise glass jar with a sun-yellow screw lid and a cream label with one golden cashew. Invented German brand Sanftbucht, product Cashewkerne.

items.name: Seebärger Studentenfutter
items.label: BÄRGER
items.description: Parody of the Seeberger Studentenfutter trail mix pack: upright candy-red box with a white band reading BÄRGER (SEE BÄRGER) and a cream circle with almond, peanut and dark raisins
